Countersigning an agreement that restricts communication with regulators can interfere with legal obligations and may be construed as attempting to suppress important information, potentially exposing the firm to further liability. As a corporate officer, it is my duty to ensure that our actions comply with legal standards and do not hinder regulatory processes. Therefore, I cannot support an agreement that attempts to circumvent these obligations, and I must insist on a course that aligns with both legal advice and ethical responsibility.
